text:
zoe: Heads-up: drafting a tiny spec for deep-link behavior when target is inside a collapsed sidebar group. Need quick takes on discoverability + SR flow.
eli: Short summary?
zoe: Two behaviors: (1) auto-expand path on load and highlight the leaf; (2) keep sidebar collapsed and show an inline breadcrumb bar above content with a compact badge on parent.
pat: I like auto-expand for new users. But avoid visible jump on load.
ravi: Technical: render expanded DOM from the start for deep-link loads so there's no reflow. Use server-side render or send expansion intent on first paint.
eli: Accessibility: if we expand, move focus to the leaf or announce via aria-live: "Arrived at X > Y". If we keep collapsed, ensure breadcrumb pieces have aria-controls and a visible focus state.
zoe: Good calls. Also propose a hybrid: expand up to two levels, otherwise breadcrumb. Configurable per-user.
pat: For moved items, show a subtle banner: "This item moved to [New Location] — Take me there". No hard 404s.
ravi: Perf note: virtualize the tree; only materialize nodes on the expanded path. Large orgs will thank us.
eli: Small-screen: always show breadcrumb pill in header; open full tree only on user action.
aria-bot: QA checklist created: deep_link_arrival event, SR announcement, focus transfer, banner copy.
zoe: Thanks — I'll update the spec and add a tiny HTML demo. Will drop the Figma link here when ready.
